protocol.name: DM20
protocol.description: Digimon Ver.20th, Pendulum Ver.20th, and Digivice Progress battle protocol

VERSION.description: Device version - use pet.version filtered to range 1..5

packets.description: Battle order, attack pattern, operation mode

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Attack pattern index (0-14 for minigame taps, 15 treated as 14)

fields.name: shot_s_l
fields.description: Left Digimon strong shot sprite index

fields.name: shot_w_l
fields.description: Left Digimon weak shot sprite index

packets.description: Right Digimon index and attribute (tag battles only, 0 for single)

fields.name: index_r
fields.description: Right Digimon roster index (0 for single battle)

packets.description: Right Digimon attack sprites (tag battles only, 0 for single)

fields.name: shot_s_r
fields.description: Right Digimon strong shot sprite (0 for single)

fields.name: shot_w_r
fields.description: Right Digimon weak shot sprite (0 for single)

packets.description: Tag meter and right Digimon power

fields.name: tag_meter
fields.description: Tag battle meter value (0 for single battle)

fields.name: power_r
fields.description: Right Digimon power (0 for single battle)

packets.description: Battle results - checksum, dodges, and hits

fields.name: check
fields.description: Checksum: value that makes sum of all nibbles % 16 == 0

fields.name: dodges
fields.description: Dodge pattern (4 bits, right to left)

fields.name: hits
fields.description: Hit pattern (4 bits, right to left, inverted for single battle)

notes.bit_order: Fields are packed big-endian (most significant bit first)
notes.packet_size: Each packet is exactly 16 bits (2 bytes, 4 hex digits)
notes.single_battle_inversion: In single battles, opponent's hits/dodges are XOR'd with 0x0F
notes.checksum_calculation: Sum all nibbles from packets 1-9 plus dodges, hits, and EOL nibbles. Check value makes total % 16 == 0
notes.attack_patterns: Pattern field (0-14) corresponds to minigame taps. See DM20_pattern.json for attack values
notes.tag_meter: In tag battles, affects attack patterns. See DM20_pattern.json for bar1/bar2 relationships
notes.attribute_mapping: Attribute encoding: Va=0, Da=1, Vi=2, empty string/default=3
